task: W89 exact authored-part colour compile candidate

finding.summary: When a named part has a current solid helper-owned colour and source paint elsewhere contains a matching color family, E.compile previously preferred source-color entries and bypassed currentPartZoneOwners. The compile could target source green on the roof rather than the current authored green zone; with missing or invalid owner proof it also fell through to that source region.

behavior.ownerEdits: One uniquely proven whole-part zone is edited with the exact new color; `_meta.zoneEdit` identifies the original zone and the existing finish is omitted (preserved). Source-palette hits outside the named part do not redirect the target.
behavior.refusal: Any matching authored zone on the requested part requires one current proof matching zone ID and part, exact solid base hex, unmuted/useRegion state, default-full base color and finish strengths, strong source identity, matching region/part mask hash, unique source-layer binding, and fully visible footprint. Missing, malformed, mismatched, duplicated, partial, or overlapping evidence yields a no-change clarification.
behavior.sourceOnly: If no authored zone hits, the existing source-color part region path remains unchanged.

limits: Actual frozen SpbProDesign.plan and SpbProEdit.plan/compile execute. The test supplies a controlled currentPartZoneOwners proof callback; it does not execute proAI currentPartZoneOwners/queueEditZones/applyQueue or the actual saved project artifact.
The companion controller patch adds defaulted baseColorStrength/baseStrength fields to the private scoped appearance proof. Runtime/native compatibility remains for root to replay before merge.
Candidate remains isolated. No root/live production source was edited; no painting was applied.
